notes: s008 could be split, giving *whereof* to ἔχει as a supplied object under rule 74's contrast clause; I kept the whole nominal expression on καύχημα, since the Greek expresses the object and *glory* is what renders that lexeme while ἔχει already has its own *hath*. Rule 73 does not apply, the ASV spelling both elements out.
s004 ἐξ takes *by* under rule 36; the ASV's gloss note *Greek out of* corroborates the token.
